description.value:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-shinobi.spells.Item.SpllKaAmaterasu0]{Amaterasu}.

You are wreathed in inextinguishable black fire. You take 2d6 (failure) or 4d6 (critical failure) persistent fire damage at the end of each of your turns. This persistent fire ignores fire resistance up to the originating Amaterasu's spell rank.

Normal recovery methods (DC 15 flat check) do not work; instead, the flames end only when: (a) you submerge fully in water, (b) the caster dismisses them as a free action, (c) you are sealed away, or (d) the caster falls unconscious for more than 1 minute.
